This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, 
to be carried out on an annually bases 
as indicated by Y1 in the title block

The frequency and sort of inspection and maintenance basically depend on the 
service conditions e.g. frequency of operation interrupted current, values and 
relative power factor as well as the installation ambient temp

This first draft initiated by eng. Abd El-Fattah Ebrahim Abd El-Salam, tested by eng. 
Mohamed Abd El-Aziz, accepted by general director eng. Hemida Abou El-Naga, 
approved by eng. Samy Salem: Head Sector, 
and certified 
by 
eng. Essam El-Din 
Sadek:
MPIS Coordinator of Alex. and West Delta Zone.

items:
A work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the voltage area.
Wear safety helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glass ... etc
Equip the CB with an operation counter.

Any CB which will only operate a few times or which will remain (ON) or (OFF) 
 for long periods, should be operated from time to time.

The CB in service should be visually inspected from outside to detect dust, 
 dirt, damage, indication from manometer.

items: Safety helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glass ... etc
Safety fence with caution marks is required
Tools set as drivers, screws, nuts
Blower, brusher, rag
Clean with dry brusher or rag the dust on the device.
Replace the damaged spring if it is damaged or oxidized.

Refit the locking rings in their housing and tighten 
 the nuts or screws suitably.

Replace the wire fasteners and reconnect the detached 
 wires.
Replace the damage insulating parts.

Clean with a rough rag soaked in a suitable solvent and 
 lubricate moderately with neutral grease the oxidized contacts.

Clean the connection and breaker terminals with a rough 
 rag soaked in suitable solvent and grease them.

Tighten the earthing connection fully and cover it with 
 neutral grease.

Check the supply voltage of the operating mechanism and 
 electrical accessories, which must be between 85-110%

Check the gas pressure using its device its value 5009 
 kpa, in temp, 20C 
 otherwise according to the curve

Carry out gas filling 
 according the procedure shown in the catalog.

Check that the circuit breaker is out of service (both 
 primary and secondary circuits isolated).

Make sure that all the circuit breaker parts are at 
 ambient temperature.

Remove the protection cover (2) and the plug (1) from 
 the gas filling valve (see fig. 1).

Apply the gas pressure checking device (see fig 2) to 
 the gas filling valve and measure the pressure.

 Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, 
to be carried out on an annually bases 
as indicated by Y1 in the title block
The frequency and sort of inspection and maintenance basically depend on the 
service conditions e.g. frequency of operation interrupted current, values and 
relative power factor as well as the installation ambient temp
This first draft initiated by eng. Abd El-Fattah Ebrahim Abd El-Salam, tested by eng. 
Mohamed Abd El-Aziz, accepted by general director eng. Hemida Abou El-Naga, 
approved by eng. Samy Salem: Head Sector, 
and certified 
by 
eng. Essam El-Din 
Sadek:
MPIS Coordinator of Alex. and West Delta Zone.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the voltage area.
Wear safety helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glass ... etc
Equip the CB with an operation counter.
Any CB which will only operate a few times or which will remain (ON) or (OFF) 
 for long periods, should be operated from time to time.
The CB in service should be visually inspected from outside to detect dust, 
 dirt, damage, indication from manometer.
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glass ... etc
Safety fence with caution marks is required
Tools set as drivers, screws, nuts

Safety fence with caution marks is required

Work to be Carried Out
Clean with dry brusher or rag the dust on the device.
Replace the damaged spring if it is damaged or oxidized.
Refit the locking rings in their housing and tighten 
 the nuts or screws suitably.
Replace the wire fasteners and reconnect the detached 
 wires.
Replace the damage insulating parts.
Clean with a rough rag soaked in a suitable solvent and 
 lubricate moderately with neutral grease the oxidized contacts.
Clean the connection and breaker terminals with a rough 
 rag soaked in suitable solvent and grease them.
Tighten the earthing connection fully and cover it with 
 neutral grease.
Check the supply voltage of the operating mechanism and 
 electrical accessories, which must be between 85-110%
Check the gas pressure using its device its value 5009 
 kpa, in temp, 20C 
 otherwise according to the curve
Carry out gas filling 
 according the procedure shown in the catalog.
Check that the circuit breaker is out of service (both 
 primary and secondary circuits isolated).
Make sure that all the circuit breaker parts are at 
 ambient temperature.
Remove the protection cover (2) and the plug (1) from 
 the gas filling valve (see fig. 1).
Apply the gas pressure checking device (see fig 2) to 
 the gas filling valve and measure the pressure.

التردد وsort الفحص وصيانة basically depend على خدمة الحالات مثل التردد تشغيل interrupted التيار، القيم والنسبي القدرة factor وكذلك تركيب ambient درجة الحرارة

أعدّ المسودة الأولى م. Abd El-Fattah Ebrahim Abd El-Salam، واختبرها م. Mohamed Abd El-Aziz، وقبلها المدير العام م. Hemida Abou El-Naga، واعتمدها م. Samy Salem: رئيس قطاع، وصادق عليها م. Essam El-Din Sadek: منسق MPIS Alex. وWest Delta المنطقة.

items: يجب إصدار أمر شغل، ومؤهل طاقم الصيانة يجب احمل مناسب فئة السلامة.
سياج الأمان مع تنبيه علامات surrounding الجهد المنطقة.
ارتدِ خوذة السلامة والحذاء وقناع التنفس ونظارة السلامة... إلخ
Equip القاطع الكهربي مع عداد التشغيل.
أي القاطع الكهربي الذي سوف فقط شغل بضعة مرات أو الذي سوف remain (على) أو (الفصل) لـ طويل periods، يجب أن يكون مُشغل من زمن إلى زمن.
القاطع الكهربي في خدمة يجب أن يكون بصرياً inspected من خارج إلى detect الغبار، الأوساخ، التلف، البيان من المانومتر.

items: خوذة السلامة والحذاء وقناع التنفس ونظارة السلامة... إلخ
يلزم وجود سياج أمان مع علامات تحذير
طقم أدوات مثل المفكات والمسامير والصواميل
البلاور، brusher، خرقة
نظف مع جفف brusher أو خرقة الغبار على الجهاز.
استبدل تالف سوستة إذا هو تالف أو oxidized.
Refit إغلاق الحلقات في الخاص بهم المبيت وأحكم ربط الصواميل أو المسامير suitably.
استبدل سلك fasteners وreconnect detached الأسلاك.
استبدل التلف الأجزاء العازلة.
نظف مع خشن خرقة soaked في مناسب المذيب وشحم moderately مع neutral الشحم oxidized الملامسات.
نظف التوصيلة والقاطع الكهربي الأطراف مع خشن خرقة soaked في مناسب المذيب والشحم هم.
أحكم ربط التأريض التوصيلة كاملاً والغطاء هو مع neutral الشحم.
افحص جهد التغذية تشغيل الآلية وكهربي accessories، الذي يجب أن يكون بين 85-110%
افحص ضغط الغاز باستخدام الجهاز القيمة 5009 kpa، في درجة الحرارة، 20C otherwise طبقاً لـ المنحنى
نفذ تعبئة الغاز طبقاً الإجراء موضح في catalog.
افحص ذلك القاطع الكهربي خارج خدمة (كلا الابتدائي والثانوي الدوائر معزول).
تأكد من أن جميع القاطع الكهربي الأجزاء عند ambient درجة الحرارة.
فك الوقاية الغطاء (2) والسدادة (1) من تعبئة الغاز الصمام (انظر شكل 1).
ضع ضغط الغاز فحص الجهاز (انظر شكل 2) إلى تعبئة الغاز الصمام وقس ضغط.

sections_ar.text: يجب أن يطابق الغاز مواصفات IEC. المنشور رقم 376 (مواصفة وقبول غاز SF6 الجديد) وأي مراجعة لاحقة وكذلك مع مواصفات CEI الإيطالية المقابلة المنشور رقم 410
هو يجب أيضاً remembered ذلك impair الغاز characteristics وcompromise functionality القاطع الكهربي.
